verse: kiṃ vā kandagataṃ devi kim vā hṛtmadhyagocaram | kiṃ vā kaṇṭhagataṃ śubhraṃ kiṃ vā tattvaṃ nāse sthitam
sthitivat tvacalā nityā daśasaptākṣarā tu sā | snānaṃ sānandabhāvena viśonmīlanatatparā
madanti sarvathā devyaḥ khacakrapadadarśitāḥ | śrībhairava uvāca śrutā etāvad vaktrābjād melāpe militā yathā
sarvamantreṣu tat sāraṃ sarvajñeyeṣu cottamam | sarvopamāmatikrāntaṃ vākkramātītagocaram
hayamāṃsāni divyāni murtamānyadhamāni ca | mantramāni suraśreṣṭa lehyacoṣyāni homayet
melāpena yathā devyo militāstu svabhāvataḥ | dvādaśa ca prayatnena viśvarūpā nirañjanāḥ
? yogīśvarīpadaṃ padaṃ paścāt prero deyān padaṃ tataḥ | eṣā tu deva deveśi caturviṃśākṣarā smṛtā
2/? parabhāvamanudīptā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | antaḥ sūkṣmā bahiḥ sūkṣmā carate yā carācare
yoginyo dvādaśa tatra yutaśca (?) tadanantaram | pīṭhāśca pīṭhasiddhāśca dūtayaśca sutejasaḥ
ṣoḍaśāraṃ śubhāraṃ vai viśvagrasanalolupam | etaccakraṃ paraṃ vyoma sṛṣṭisthitalayaṃkaram
adhomārgena rephatvaṃ sarvatra pānalolupā | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
na varṇaṃ na ca avarṇaṃ na kṣaraṃ cākṣaraṃ na tu | etat svarūpamamalaṃ akrame tu kramāgatam
parāparepadaṃ paścāt saraditke padaṃ tataḥ | kalākalepadaṃ yojya śūnyaśāntapadaṃ tataḥ
sṛṣṭicakrasya deveśa daśamaṃ sarvathoditam | saṃhārāt saptamaṃ yuktaṃ sthiternavamalāṃcchitam
dvitīyametat kathitaṃ tṛtīyamadhunā śṛṇu | sṛṣṭirdaśamasaṃsthaṃ tu saṃhārāt saptame yutam
antāntā tu anantā sā a ṛlāntamadhyagā | bindudvayasya madhyasthā prakaṭasthā tu turyagā
saṃhārādaṣṭamaṃ varṇaṃ sthiternavamalāṃcchitam | prathamaṃ taṃ vijānīyād dvitīyamadhunā śṛṇu
gopanīyāḥ pālayeta mūrtayaśca mahārthadāḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena ādau pūjyāstu ṣoḍaśa
kiṃ vā śivagataṃ śāntaṃ kiṃ vā sarvottamaṃ dhruvam | kiṃ vā śūnyamaśūnyaṃ vā kiṃ vā śūnyāntarāntaram
avyakte acyute brahme parame viśvarūpake | sākāre tu nirākāre sarvākāre namo'stu te
yad jñātvā bodhaśālīnāṃ prabuddhānām umādha ca | ? khegatirbhavate sadyaḥ sarvabhāvakṣayaṃkarī
3/ khadaṇḍe tu adaṇḍā sā daṇḍāṇḍādaṇḍarūpiṇī | khadaṇḍādaṇḍayormadhye svaraśmigasaṃvartinī
siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ tu svarūpapadadarśakī | tataḥ saṃjñā prakartavyā ante pāde nirodhayet
tataḥ mānavākhya kramasthā saṃhārakasvarūpiṇī | (?) tatrasthā sarvabhāvāntā bodhābodha taraṅginī
eta sa* * *? tathyaṃ kathayasva mamepsitam | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu tattvaṃ yathārthaṃ vai sṛṣṭicakrasya yā vidhiḥ
samayāṃ pūrayed rudra bāhyato vīranāyaka | gurupaṃktiryathārthato ādau pūjyā suyatnataḥ
āṇavaṃ na ca vai rudraḥ svasvabhāvaṃ na caiva hi | na jñānaṃ na ca tat jñeyaṃ na bodhaṃ na ca budhyate
nirantaraṃ nirābhāsaṃ nirnimittaṃ nirargalam | nirākāśaṃ sadākāśaṃ sarvodoṣavivarjitam
melāpe militā sā vai jñānasya paramā citiḥ | (12) etāstu kathitā devyaḥ melāpe yāḥ khamārgagāḥ
brāhmaṇī pukkasī caiva dhvajinī antyajā tathā | cakriṇī ca tathā cchipyi śauṇḍikī kṣatrīṇī tathā
adhyātma bhāvavibhavo dayanātmarūpālīlāpare taraṇi gurumahārthasiddhau | tat saṃhṛtiḥ sthitipadaṃ punarāviśanti muṣṭisvabhāvamapahṛdityakalāntakītām
etat pūjākramaṃ ghoraṃ vīradravyaiśca sarvataḥ | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā nirvikalpatayā saha
nityaśūnyanirānande ṣaṭcakre avyaye dhruve | taṃ tu vīryavaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mantratattvaṃ svarūpataḥ
sṛṣṭirdaśamasaṃsthaṃ tu saṃhārādaṣṭame yutam | sthitisthena śirākrāntaṃ navamena vidhānataḥ
mukhyaṃtu sarvavidyānāṃ sarvasānnirmukārakam | sṛṣṭirūpaṃ sthitisthaṃ ca saṃhārakaraṇodyatam
etaccakraṃ tu cakreśaṃ sarvabhāvakṣayaṃkaram | sarvakāmaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvasānnidhyakārakam
akṣavyañjanamārūḍhā khecaratvapradāyinī | satatoditabhāvasthā antasthā citsvarūpiṇī
paramasiddhi ca padaṃ śuddhaśabdamataḥ param | bahuśabdaṃ tatoddhṛtya svarūpe ca padaṃ tataḥ
saṃhāraṇopasaṃyuktā prapañcāṃvabhāvataḥ | vādya tu vartalāre antasvaraistu sāvṛtā
yaistu siddhairmahāvīraiḥ kramaughamavatāritam | te pūjyāḥ sarvadā rudra puṣpadhūpopahārakaiḥ
aṣṭamasyāvavasthaṃ tu sthitikāranasaṃyutam | navamena śirākrāntaṃ varṇamidaṃ dvitīyakam
śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me tava vaktrābjāt siddhānāṃ bodhaśālinām | yoginīnāṃ yathārthatvaṃ vidyā sarvārthadeśakī
dhāmatrayasya sā kālī bhāsamānā aharniśi | aṃbhāṣā sarvato hikkā bhāṣakābhāṣakī sadā
śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me paramaṃ guhyaṃ siddhapāraṃparāgatam | yoginīnāṃ paraṃ sāraṃ kramasadbhāvamuttamam
na kule kaulike devi śrutaṃ me kramaśāsane | kramaṃ tu kīdṛśaṃ devi raśmisthāne pratiṣṭhitam
jñātavyā sarvadā kālī kramaṇī parameśvarī | tapasthitipadāntasthā dīrghāmbarāvilambinī
daśasaptādhikaṃ viddhi varṇakālakṣayaṃkaram | eṣā tu paramā kālī daśasaptādhikākṣarā
eṣā tu devadeveśi daśasaptākṣarādhikā | vidyāvidyeśvarī ghorā kālanirnāśanī śivā
saptādaśeti vikhyātā akṣarārthānuyāyinī | asyāḥ svarūpaṃ tu bhāvajña jñātvā vākye tu yojayet
siddhānāṃ yoginīnām tu tava vaktrāt maheśvari | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi siddhānāṃ sthiticakragām
tataḥ pūjyā maheśāna rājaputrāśca sādhakaiḥ | dvādaśa ca samāsena gurūddiṣṭena karmaṇā
bhavate nātra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ punaḥ prākṛto janaḥ | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me devadeveśi jñānaṃ paramadurlabham
sarvasyākṣararūpasya nakṣatrasya tathā vidhiḥ | bhāsayet sā parā kālī bhābhirugrābhitārakam
mukhapāraṃparāyātaṃ mukhapāraṃparojjhitam | mukhasāraṃ parāvasthāṃ ko naraḥ prāpyanāṣṇute
etāstu * *? tā devyaḥ sarvagrasanalampaṭāḥ | catvāra urmayo devyāḥ śāṃbhavyudadhimadhyagāḥ
na lekhyaṃ lekhanīyaṃ vā na ca jāpāntaraṃ kvacit | na śuddhaṃ na ca vāśuddhaṃ na śāktaṃ na ca śāṃbhavam
te siddhāḥ paramārthatve kāyasthānavivarjjitā | sadāyuktāya dhīrāya pūjakāya mahāsiddhāḥ
tārayet sarvajantūnāṃ araṇḍa paśvaśca? sadā | praviṣṭasya praviṣṭā sā niryā *? gantugāminī
pūjyā vandyāḥ prayatnena gurūddiṣṭena (gurudṛṣṭena) karmaṇā | pūjanīyaṃ paraṃ divyaṃ malāpaṃ sarvajantuṣu
guptācāreṇa vai nityaṃ pañcadhā tu yathārthataḥ | idaṃ vai yoginīcakraṃ khecaratvapradāyakam
cakrācāraratāḥ kecid kecid dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ | vīrapānaratāḥ kecid haṭhamelāpake ratāḥ
sarvasvaṃ sarvadehasthaṃ sarvādyaṃ sarvakāraṇam | sarvopamāmatikrāntaṃ śāstraṃ śāstravivarjitam
khaṇḍajñānena sā devī khaṇḍacakraikatāṃ gatā | bhāsvarairdivasairyuktā (?) śikhā bhargasya cottamā
śrībhairavyūvāca sthiticakrasya madhye tu yā pūjyā khakārāntagā | kālī vidyeti vikhyātā tava snehādihādya vai
recakaiḥ purakaiḥścaiva kumbhakaiśca viśeṣataḥ ||1/ 58 ||
sarvabhūtāstu sarve ca grastāstasmin  mahāhave  ||2/10 ||
namo harthāntu tasyaiva mūlaṃ (?) saṃharaṇe kṣame | namo'stu te mahāraudri saumyarūpe namo'stu te
khecaryaśca tato deva bhūcaryaśca tataḥ param | dikcaryaśca tathā rudra gocaryaśca tathā hara
tataḥ samuccared vidyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām | trayodaśaṃ tu saṃhārād sṛṣṭidaśamasaṃyutam
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate sadyaḥ krameṇānena bhairava | etad vai kathitaṃ vīra kramasyodbhāvanirṇayam
yena vijñātamātreṇa bhavāmi kramabhājanaḥ | ke siddhāstasya tattvasya pāramparyavyavasthitāḥ
haṭharāvā  arāvasthā rāveṇa haṭhabhakṣakī  ||2/28 ||
gandharvaiḥ kinnarairdivyaiḥ sādhyaiśca  vasubhistathā ||1/ 46 ||
yasya vijñātamātreṇa sthitijño bhavate dhruvam | gāmihātve yathārthatve kathayāmi vṛṣāsane
pānāni bahave dadyād vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet | śavāsanastho vīrendro yoginī vātha suvrataḥ
śrībhairava uvāca pṛcchāmi paramaṃ devi svavimarśabalena tu | agragā tu parā devyā saṃhārakaraṇakṣamā
3/ cidbhānuścitsvarūpatvāccandraṃśeṣu ca madhyagā | (?) anākhyā ca sthitāstatra cakracakreśvarī sadā
yā pūjyā sṛṣṭicakrasthā kālī sarvārthanāyakī | sā vidyā tava vakṣyāmi vinimarṣakalena ca
śrībhairavyuvāca idānīṃ śṛṇu deveśi sthiticakrasya yāṃ vidhim | pūjyate parayā bhaktyā svasthā sarvārthamadhyagā
anekacaṭtārāvaiḥ sevyamānaṃ mahākulam | anekayoginīvṛndai veṣṭālaṃ kālavoṣṭitam
catuḥṣaṣṭistu deveśyāstattvarūpāḥ  parāyaṇāḥ  ||2/6 ||
saṃhārakaraṇodyuktā bhāvenānena sarvataḥ | vidyārūpā tu ṣaṣṭhyantā kālīkā kanahehu -u
yena vijñānamātreṇa kramavijñānabhāvagaḥ | bhavate sādhakendro vai bodhābodhavibodhakaḥ
mūrtayastu mahākāla kāyena manasā girā | paścāt siddhakramaṃ pūjyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam
yatra garbhatrayodayaṃ mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | rākākārā kuhūrūpā kuhunākāśabhakṣakī
kathayāmi yathā tathyaṃ vistareṇa yathākramam | yena vijñātamātrena khecarīsamatāṃ vrajet
pādau jagrāha tasyā vai stutipūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ | abravīt tu samāsena bhairavo bhairavīṃ tataḥ
sṛṣṭisthaṃ saptamaṃ yad vai saṃhārādaṣṭasaṃyutam | navamaṃ taṃ vijāniyād daśamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
viddhi bhairava jñānena sarvautkṛṣṭatayādhipa | sthitisthaṃ dvādaśamaṃ vai daśapañcamakaṃ viduḥ
bhairavarūpadhāriṇyo  vyomni vyomagatā matāḥ ||2/14 ||
saṃhārastu mahākālo melāpaṃ paramaṃ viduḥ | anākhyaṃ śaktibhāvaṃ tu bhāsākhyaṃ śaktirūpakam
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena gurubhaktena kramagāḥ | tāsāṃ tu yoginīnāṃ ca pāraṃparyagatāni ca
tena tena svarūpena vyomaiśyaḥ  sarvabhāvataḥ ||2/24 ||
bhavati sā kramārthābhā viditvā kālikākramam | iti śrīmaduttarapīṭhavinirgate śrīśrīnāthapādāvatārite śrīkālikākramakramasadbhāve catuḥṣaṣṭivibhavāvatāro nāma dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ
nistaraṅge tadoddhṛtya pareti ca padaṃ tathā | parāparepadaṃ paścāt sarvadikya padaṃ tataḥ
melāpe militā sā vai śabdasya paramā citiḥ | (1) tvaggatā sarvabhūteṣu viśve'aasmin sacarācare
yadetat kathitaṃ tattvaṃ tena snehena bhairava | tat tu jñānaṃ mahādīptaṃ sarvajñāneṣu cottamam
niḥsvabhāvamahāvasthā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | sthulagā yāmadrodikkā (?) akṣarakṣaramadhyagā
sthitisthaṃ dvādaśamaṃ yad vai daśapaṃcamakaṃ viduḥ | sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ yat tu saṃhārādaṣṭame yutam
saṃhāracakre deveśa trayodaśamamagrataḥ | uddharet tu vidhānena sṛṣṭirdaśamasaṃyutam
